Charming real ingredient shapes, art-school food magazine quality, restrained texture inside colored shapes, contemporary joyful European food editorial illustration, clear silhouette at small size. Not a cartoon mascot, no face, no 3D, no photorealism, no white background. All shapes fully in frame with generous margins.
